CustomField.formula:
IF( ISPICKVAL(Add_Shift__r.Shift_Type__c, "Sleepover Shift"), Staff_Final_Hourly_Rate__c,
IF( ISPICKVAL(Add_Shift__r.Shift_Type__c, "Custom"), (Long_Morning_Hourly_Rate__c * Long_Morning_Shift_Duartion__c) + (Long_Afternoon_Hourly_Rate__c * Long_Afternoon_Shift_Duartion__c) + (Long_Night_Hourly_Rate__c * Long_Night_Shift_Duartion__c) + Long_Sleepover_Allowance__c,
Staff_Final_Hourly_Rate__c * Actual_Duration__c ) )
CustomField.label: Shift Wages
